producer_judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class IX Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes (same statement-type grain) in Chapter 3 'Atoms and Molecules' under the Materials domain. CLO15 ('Uses symbols of elements and valencies to write formulae of compounds.') and CLO12 ('Explains atoms, molecules and represents compounds using chemical formulae; the concept of the mole and relates it with molecular mass.') share substantive content: chemical representation of compounds by formulae. They sit at the same canonical coordinate rank (Class IX, rank 0), and the evidence does not substantively settle a developmental direction — CLO12's conceptual account of atoms/molecules and the mole could equally precede or follow the procedural valency-based formula-writing skill of CLO15, and the two differ in scope rather than in demonstrated dependency (CLO12 additionally covers mole and molecular mass, which CLO15 does not touch). This is meaningful, non-generic conceptual coherence within one chapter, so a symmetric relatesTo is supported while a same-rank buildsTowards is not. Endpoints carry upstream merge/audit context (CLO12 merged from duplicate window extractions; CLO15 deliberately kept separate from identically worded CLO19) and both have truncated source evidence, so unseen source text could refine but does not contradict this judgment.
